title: Tiny Recursive Message Passing
abstract: arXiv:2610.18649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture. Recent work has shown that better results can be achieved using recursive transformers trained with deep supervision and truncated recursions, which make extremely deep loops stable to train, and equipped with test-time procedures such as discrete deduction lattices. In this work, we apply the same procedures to message passing networks, and show that the two ingredients are complementary, and lead to parameter efficient models: we obtain about $99\%$ test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with a model of $16$k parameters that trains in about $10$ minutes on an H100, or in $9$ hours on a CPU. We further show that the cost of truncating gradients grows with the number of rounds information needs to cross the graph, making the choice of wiring a trade-of

translated_abstract: 消息传递神经网络在算法和约束推理任务中表现出卓越性能，这得益于它们能够将任务结构直接编码到网络架构中。近期研究表明，使用深度监督和截断递归训练的递归变换器可以获得更好的结果，这些方法使极深的循环能够稳定训练，并配备了诸如离散推理格等测试时程序。在这项工作中，我们将相同的技术应用于消息传递网络，并证明这两个要素是互补的，可以构建参数高效的模型：我们使用一个仅 16k 参数的模型在 Sudoku-Extreme 上取得了约 99% 的测试准确率，该模型在 H100 上训练约 10 分钟，或在 CPU 上训练 9 小时。我们进一步表明，截断梯度的代价随着信息跨越图所需的轮数增加而增长，这使得网络布线的选择成为一种权衡。
tldr: 将深度监督、截断递归和测试时推理等技术引入消息传递神经网络，仅用 16k 参数的微型模型就在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到约 99% 的测试准确率，可在 H100 上 10 分钟或 CPU 上 9 小时内完成训练。
en_tdlr: By combining deep supervision, truncated recursions, and test-time procedures with message passing networks, a tiny 16k-parameter model achieves ~99% test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, trainable in about 10 minutes on an H100 or 9 hours on a CPU.
